items.text: Imports and cleanup now free device space sooner and more reliably, including faster Clear local files with accurate freed-space reporting and better cleanup after sign-out or reset.
Deleting and restoring folders now behaves more predictably, and share links stay accurate when files move to and from trash.
Uploads now show clearer states for waiting, full storage, and failed files, and retries back off instead of looping continuously.
Files moved to trash before upload now leave the upload queue, and restored files rejoin upload normally.
Library browsing is faster and steadier in large libraries, including load-more behavior and photo viewer recovery after a failed load.
Switching to a different file source now keeps files available on device until the new source can provide them.
